description: This file contains the implementation of the Zend_Http_Cookie class, which models an HTTP cookie with parameters such as name, value, domain, path, expiry, and security attributes. It includes methods for creating cookies, checking if they are expired or secure, matching cookies to URIs, and parsing cookie strings.

classes.name: Zend_Http_Cookie
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP cookie with parameters for name, value, domain, path, expiry, and security attributes. Provides methods for cookie validation, matching, string conversion, and creation from strings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an HTTP cookie with provided parameters, validating the name and domain.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the cookie.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the cookie.

methods.name: getDomain
methods.description: Returns the domain of the cookie.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the cookie.

methods.name: getExpiryTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry timestamp of the cookie, or null if not set.

methods.name: isSecure
methods.description: Indicates if the cookie is secure.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.description: Checks if the cookie has expired based on the current time or provided timestamp.

methods.name: isSessionCookie
methods.description: Checks if the cookie is a session cookie (no expiry time).

methods.name: match
methods.description: Determines whether the cookie should be sent for a given URI, considering security, expiry, domain, and path.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the cookie as a string suitable for the Cookie HTTP header.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a new Zend_Http_Cookie object from a cookie string, optionally using a reference URI for default parameters.

methods.name: matchCookieDomain
methods.description: Static method that checks if a cookie's domain matches a given host.

methods.name: matchCookiePath
methods.description: Static method that checks if a cookie's path matches a given URL path.
